ruling: Use the source status field to distinguish current (active) deals from deleted deals; current means the source reports the deal as active, not deleted.
detail: Operator confirmed the status value 'deleted' marks a tombstoned record that must be excluded from the active output.

ruling: Owner name and owner email are dropped at ingestion and never land in any stored surface of this product, raw or served.
detail: Operator instruction: keep owner and email details redacted.

ruling: This product does not compute, land, or expose a priority or attention ranking of deals, because no ranking threshold was supplied.
detail: Operator instruction: do not rank records by attention because no threshold is provided.
